about: What stops a character, and a pad that flings one. Four walls of building blocks stand across a lane at x = 5, 9, 13 and 17, 1.3, 1.6, 2.0 and 2.4 m high, and a fifth of 3 m at x = 25 whose model the stage graph switches off (f.activateDisableModelDisplay): an invisible wall. The class may neither jump nor climb. The player walks into the first wall from second 3 (measured 2026-10-12: it stops at x = 4.6, in front of the 1.3 m wall, for as long as the key is held); at 7 it is put at x = 21 and walks on: it stops at x = 24.65 with nothing to be seen there. At 12 it is put at x = -13 and walks over a flat pad at x = -8 that flings 14 m/s straight up (launcher). Expect WL_GO, and read playerTrack.
